capabilities: organize chapters into volumes and article groups with drag-and-drop ordering and statuses
write in a plain-text novel editor with pending-revision blocks, auto formatting, and live typography settings
manage worldbuilding records with tags, custom fields, and a relationship graph
import and export manuscripts in a volume/chapter/body TXT format
find and replace across chapter, volume, book, and keyword scopes
disambiguation: Not just a viewing mode; it restructures a folder into a novel workspace with its own article list, editor, and setting-collection sidebars.
extras: Desktop-only (Windows/macOS/Linux) and requires Obsidian 1.7.2+; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Full docs are in the README plus a docs/DESIGN.md and a demo novel group.
problem: Obsidian's Markdown-centric file explorer and editor don't support chapter ordering, volume structure, chapter statuses, or linked setting records for long-form fiction.
summary: Novel-writing workflow that turns a folder into a novel group with volumes, chapters, worldbuilding records, a plain-text editor, and TXT import/export.
